decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight sits close to the firm's established system offer, the industry's turnover growth points to performance at or above aspiration and some slack, and its dedicated page gives no sign of a shortfall that would prompt problemistic search.

The LED ceiling luminaire is a core-adjacent product with a page of its own and no sign of underperformance, so in a growing industry with a broad portfolio management has no reason to search for alternative uses of its resources.
